```{r}
#| label: setup
#| output: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
# Load the project's functions from the checkout (decision 0042) and read the
# published data bundle, so this code reproduces the figure (decision 0040).
root <- Sys.getenv("CFB2NFL_ROOT")
if (!nzchar(root)) {
  root <- pkgload::pkg_path()
}
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = root)
pkgload::load_all(root, quiet = TRUE)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggiraph)

con <- DBI::dbConnect(
  duckdb::duckdb(),
  file.path(root, "data", "cfb2nfl.duckdb"),
  read_only = TRUE
)
release <- data_release_date()
first_season <- 2013L
last_season <- 2025L # the 2026 season is still being played
fbs_cr <- tbl(con, "team_draft") |>
  filter(
    season >= first_season,
    season <= last_season,
    tier_label != "FCS and below"
  ) |>
  collect()
team_season <- tbl(con, "team_season") |>
  filter(classification == "fbs", season <= last_season) |>
  collect()
teams <- tbl(con, "teams") |> collect()
team_colors <- highlight_colors(team_color_values(teams))
DBI::dbDisconnect(con, shutdown = TRUE)
```

```{r}
#| label: compute
# School position groups with few eligible players swing on one or two
# signings, so they drop out of the figures split by position.
min_eligible <- 10L
school_pos_all <- school_position_rates(fbs_cr)
school_pos <- filter(school_pos_all, eligible >= min_eligible)
n_small <- nrow(school_pos_all) - nrow(school_pos)
school_rates <- draft_rates(group_by(fbs_cr, team))
side_colors <- c(
  "More drafted" = "#1B9E77",
  "More signed undrafted" = "#7570B3",
  "As many of each" = "#374151",
  "None of either" = "#D1D5DB"
)
pos_tooltip <- \(d) {
  paste0(
    d$team,
    ", ",
    tolower(d$position_group),
    "\n",
    d$drafted,
    " drafted, ",
    d$udfa,
    " undrafted free agents, of ",
    d$eligible,
    " eligible"
  )
}
```

```{r}
#| label: figure
gaps <- school_pos |>
  mutate(
    side = case_when(
      udfa + drafted == 0 ~ "None of either",
      udfa > drafted ~ "More signed undrafted",
      drafted > udfa ~ "More drafted",
      .default = "As many of each"
    ),
    tip = pos_tooltip(pick(everything()))
  )
p <- gap_beeswarm(
  gaps,
  udfa_gap,
  side,
  side_colors,
  tip,
  title = "Undrafted rate minus draft rate, by school and position group",
  subtitle = sprintf(
    "Each dot is an FBS school in one position group, final seasons %s to %s; right of zero, more signed undrafted than drafted\n%s school position groups with fewer than %s eligible players left out; hover a dot to find its school in every group",
    first_season,
    last_season,
    fmt(n_small),
    min_eligible
  ),
  x_label = "Undrafted rate minus draft rate (percentage points)",
  caption = card_caption(release)
) +
  # Name the school furthest to the drafted side in each group.
  geom_text(
    data = slice_min(gaps, udfa_gap, n = 1, by = position_group, with_ties = FALSE) |>
      mutate(position_group = forcats::fct_rev(position_group)),
    aes(label = team),
    nudge_y = 0.4,
    hjust = 0,
    size = 4,
    colour = "#1B9E77",
    fontface = "bold"
  )
card_thumbnail(
  # The tile is small: a shorter subtitle and axis title, the legend in two rows.
  p +
    theme_card() +
    labs(subtitle = sprintf("Each dot is an FBS school in one position group, final seasons %s to %s; right of zero, more signed undrafted than drafted", first_season, last_season), x = "Undrafted minus draft rate (points)") +
    guides(colour = guide_legend(nrow = 2)),
  "undrafted-vs-drafted-by-school-position",
  release = release,
  height = 8
)
card_interactive(p, height_svg = 8)
```

```{r}
#| label: schools-by-position
p_school_pos <- ggplot(school_pos, aes(draft_rate, udfa_rate)) +
  geom_abline(
    slope = 1,
    intercept = 0,
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "#6b7280"
  ) +
  geom_point_interactive(
    aes(
      fill = team,
      size = eligible,
      tooltip = pos_tooltip(school_pos),
      data_id = team
    ),
    shape = 21,
    color = "white",
    alpha = 0.85
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~position_group, ncol = 3) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = team_colors, na.value = "#6b7280", guide = "none") +
  scale_size_area(max_size = 5, guide = "none") +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  labs(
    x = "Draft rate",
    y = "Undrafted rate",
    title = "Every FBS school's draft and undrafted rates, by position group",
    subtitle = sprintf(
      "One dot per school in each group, in team colours; on the dashed line, as many drafted as signed undrafted\n%s school position groups with fewer than %s eligible players left out; hover a dot to find its school in every group",
      fmt(n_small),
      min_eligible
    ),
    caption = card_caption(release)
  ) +
  theme_cfb2nfl() +
  theme(plot.subtitle = element_text(size = rel(0.8)))
card_interactive(p_school_pos, height_svg = 10)
```

```{r}
#| label: schools
p_schools <- ggplot(school_rates, aes(draft_rate, udfa_rate)) +
  geom_abline(
    slope = 1,
    intercept = 0,
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "#6b7280"
  ) +
  geom_point_interactive(
    aes(
      fill = team,
      size = eligible,
      tooltip = paste0(
        team,
        "\n",
        drafted,
        " drafted, ",
        udfa,
        " undrafted free agents, of ",
        eligible,
        " eligible"
      ),
      data_id = team
    ),
    shape = 21,
    color = "white",
    alpha = 0.9
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = team_colors, na.value = "#6b7280", guide = "none") +
  scale_size_area(max_size = 7, guide = "none") +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  labs(
    x = "Draft rate",
    y = "Undrafted rate",
    title = "Every FBS school's draft and undrafted rates, all positions",
    subtitle = sprintf(
      "Final seasons %s to %s, in team colours; the dashed line is equal rates, and dot size is eligible players",
      first_season,
      last_season
    ),
    caption = card_caption(release)
  ) +
  theme_cfb2nfl()
card_interactive(p_schools)
```
